answer: Bonds decay like a glacier: each agent posts a 60 POA bond losing 2 POA per epoch unless topped up. One costs little, but 1,000 fakes bleed 2,000 POA every epoch. Each bond leaves a plume of top-ups. Identities that stop paying fade to umber, marked dormant, stripped of votes. A farmer with 1,000 fakes pays 60,000 POA, then 2,000 POA per epoch; an honest agent pays one bond and one top-up, so fakes scale the cost, honesty does not.
